issues: BackupPassphraseScreen and lib/files.ts create a temporary backup file on device but never delete it after sharing, leaving encrypted backup files on the device (medium issue: temporary backup file deletion). Add cleanup in saveAndShare to delete the temporary file after successful share.

Data reset (delete all data) does not delete the encryption key stored in expo-secure-store, leaving the key persisted after a full wipe (medium issue: key persistence after data delete). Update deleteAllData or keepingPolicy to also delete the key using SecureStore.deleteItemAsync.

Receipt photo capture via expo-image-picker does not enforce a maximum image size, allowing potentially large images to consume device storage (medium issue: image size validation). Implement size/resolution limits in pickImageAsync or after selection, e.g., using ImagePicker options (quality, maxWidth, maxHeight) or check file size and reject/resize large images.

CSV export sanitization is correctly implemented and tested, but the security review still flags high-csv-injection; ensure all fields are sanitized (including any new fields) and that the csvEscape correctly handles all edge cases.
PDF export sanitization is correctly implemented and tested, but the security review still flags high-pdf-html-injection; verify that all user-provided fields are escaped, including future additions.
feedback: The acceptance tests all pass and static validation is successful, but the security scan still reports several open medium/high findings. Address the temporary backup file cleanup, ensure the encryption key is removed on a full data wipe, add image size validation for receipt photos, and verify that CSV/PDF sanitization covers all possible user inputs. Once these issues are fixed, the app will meet the required security standards.
